result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active unmatched contributors.

**Change:** `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, in `getAllTeams()`. The remainder condition now also requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`:

```java
if (!added[0] && contributor.getContributor().isActive() && !remainder.getMembers().contains(email)) {
```

Configured teams are untouched, so their members stay in whether active or not. A blank latest-commit date passes `isActive()` because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for blank input, so those contributors are kept.

**Verification:** `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test` passed, with 0 failures and 0 errors across the surefire reports. No existing test covers the landscape team grouping, so I did not add one. The `reports` module was not rebuilt or tested. Nothing is committed.
